テキスト cha 504: Born Shiyo 780, March 3. Height 160cm (as of Shiyo 800). Erina Goto's older sister and the eldest daughter of the Goto. She seems to be on bad terms with her younger sister Erina Goto.

She dropped out of high school and has lived on part-time jobs ever since. In middle school she passed Grade 2 of the Eiken English test and Grade Pre-1 of the Kanken kanji test, among other things; academically she was quite outstanding.
There is a description that reads as though she is involved with several men at the same time. Her younger sister, Erina Goto, thinks she is living a loose life.

To Erina Goto, back alive from the Kogori house, she says "It is strange that Natsumi Kogori does not know Eiichiro Niimura is dead". That makes Erina Goto notice what does not fit in the conversation between Natsumi Kogori and Haruka Niimura.

Hearing that Erina Goto has been taken into police protection, she leaves her part-time job early at once. She also cannot forgive anyone who speaks ill of her younger sister, among other things, so she does not seem to dislike her sister all that much.

When she meets her sister again at the police station she silently lends her a shoulder and the like, and no bad blood can be felt there. It can even be sensed that inside she wants to build a good relationship with her sister.

She works at the cafe 'Primavera', which is strict about whom it hires. Her attitude at work, her manners and her looks are flawless on every count, and many regulars come again and again just for her.

During Golden Week, about a month after the incident was resolved, she speaks to Erina Goto. She seems to have learned that Erina Goto was involved in resolving the incident, but she tells her an unexpected truth about the accident that killed Eiichiro Niimura 12 years ago.
When Eiichiro Niimura died, she seems to have been at Central Park with her younger sister Erina, and she witnessed the accident.

As a fifth grader, she had come to Zahha with Erina Goto, then not yet in school. After Ryoji Kogori left the table she also looked after Natsumi Kogori, and she was polite to Ryoji Kogori as well; she comes across as mature for her age.
At Megasawa Zoo with her family, she seems to have been searching desperately for Erina Goto, who had wandered off alone. She left without forgetting to thank Ryoji Kogori for Zahha.
From a certain day on, she suddenly begins to reject her younger sister, Erina Goto. Until then they even seem to have been close sisters. A month after that, Momoko Goto drops out of high school.

She spends a holiday with her family for once, but she is as curt as ever toward her younger sister, Erina Goto. Still, she rescues Erina when she nearly gets lost and goes into a haunted house with her, so it seems she does not reject her completely.

シナリオ名: 生まれ変わる家族たち
テキスト cha 504: She pushed her younger sister, Erina Goto, away out of fear: Erina was so smart that Momoko feared she would one day lose her place as the older sister and be written off. If so, she reasoned, she had to leave home and stand on her own before that happened, so she quit high school and worked part-time jobs every day. She pours out these feelings to Erina, who encourages her with "No matter what, I'll protect our bond as sisters," and, however awkwardly, she begins to take a step toward her sister.

シナリオ名: 生まれ変わる家族たち
テキスト cha 504: As a small child, she saw a baby born to one of her mother's friends and came to long for a little sister of her own. The name Erina was her choice too. From the time her sister was born until she began keeping her distance, the two were always together.

シナリオ名: 生まれ変わる家族たち
テキスト cha 504: Super Soda Bomber is her favorite, and she is even more passionate about it than Haruka Niimura.

She goes alone to the Arata settlement to avenge her sister Erina Goto on Mifuyu Niimura and the settlement. Kana Niimura melts her vengefulness, and she gives up revenge. Just then, residents who fear Kana attack, killing Sakura and Kotaro Niimura. Perhaps from Sakura's blood on her, she is seized by irresistible murderous intent toward Kana and Haruka Niimura and shoots them. Blaming the settlement, she kills every last resident, then dies facing her fate, in ugly regret, loving her sister.
